title: WJEC Eduqas GCSE (9-1) English Language — Component 2: 19th and 21st Century Non-Fiction Reading and Transactional/Persuasive Writing (C700U20-1)

authority.file: MSR/EDUQAS GCSE English/EDUQAS GCSE English Language Paper 2/Mark Scheme for Eduqas English Language Paper 2/November 2022 MS - Component 2 Eduqas English Language GCSE.pdf
authority.why_this_source: The board's own published mark scheme — top of the authority order. Second series read for the recurring pattern: the Autumn 2021 mark scheme in the same folder (Microsoft-Word-C700U20-1-EDUQUAS-GCSE-English-Lang-Comp-2-MS-A21.docx.pdf) carries the identical tariff set and band ladders, and the June 2024 mark scheme extract (June 2024 MS - Component 2 Eduqas English Language GCSE Transactional Writing.pdf) carries the same Section B grid. The Q2/Q4 AO annotations were already corrected against this PDF on 2026-09-05 (spec JSON source line). A FOURTH series was read for the tariff pattern on 2026-09-13: the June 2022 question paper (Reading Sources for EDUQAS Language Paper 2/z22-c700u20-1a.pdf) prints the same set 1+1+1 / 10 / 1+1+1 / 10 / 4 / 10 / 20 / 20.
authority.path_note: The paper numbers Section A as 1.1–1.6 and Section B as 2.1 and 2.2. Our spec models them as Q1a/b/c, Q2, Q3a/b/c, Q4, Q5, Q6, Q7, Q8 — same marks, different labels.

total.why: The mark scheme states 'SECTION A: 40 MARKS' and 'Section B (40 marks)', never an 80. (1+1+1)+10+(1+1+1)+10+4+10 = 40 (Section A) + 20+20 = 40 (Section B) = 80, which matches language-paper-specs.json.

Both tasks are compulsory and share ONE grid, headed '2 1 + 2 2 Transactional / Persuasive Writing' (page 12); that heading is this question's locator and its two component columns ('12 marks' / '8 marks') sit directly under it. questions.note: Two compulsory tasks, 20 marks each. The MARK SCHEME prints no word guidance and says only that 'responses which are very short will be self-penalising'; the QUESTION PAPER does print one — 'You should aim to write about 300-400 words for each task' (June 2023, November 2022 and June 2022 all identical). Corrected 2026-09-13 — the earlier note said no word guidance is printed on the paper. Five bands each for AO5 (11-12 / 8-10 / 5-7 / 3-4 / 1-2) and AO6 (8 / 6-7 / 4-5 / 2-3 / 1), applied 'best-fit'.
